sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Rhynt is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He takes care of all the records and books in the Imperial Library, located at the Imperial Capital Randall. He also works alongside Noel in the Summoners' Research Lab into purifying several evolution crystals of Mock Units and helped simulate various Grand Quests focusing over the heroes of the past.

sections.title: Debut Appearance
sections.content: Upon the Summoner's first visit in the Imperial Library, Rhynt greets it and gives the Summoner the basics of the Imperial Library's functions.

sections.title: In the storyline
sections.content:
In Virtual Garden's prologue cutscene, Rhynt was quite bothered on how a troublesome Paris and Noel are talking inside the building.

Rhynt later appears in other several Grand Quest cutscenes, mostly when an alternate ending is triggered, in which he is quite fascinated that Noel added such features in the system.

sections.title: Trivia
sections.content:
- According to Brave Frontier Storybook:
- His birth date is January 28
- His height is 58.3 cm.
- His weight is 6.7 kg.
- He has about 26 siblings.

Rhynt is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game. He takes care of all the records and books in the Imperial Library, located at the Imperial Capital Randall. He also works alongside Noel in the Summoners' Research Lab into purifying several evolution crystals of Mock Units and helped simulate various Grand Quests focusing over the heroes of the past.


==Debut Appearance==
Upon the Summoner's first visit in the Imperial Library, Rhynt greets it and gives the Summoner the basics of the Imperial Library's functions.

==In the storyline==
In [[GQ:Paris|Virtual Garden]]'s prologue cutscene, Rhynt was quite bothered on how a troublesome Paris and Noel are talking inside the building.

Rhynt later appears in other several Grand Quest cutscenes, mostly when an alternate ending is triggered, in which he is quite fascinated that Noel added such features in the system.
